Gecko dry adhesives excel on clean, smooth, nonporous surfaces, leading to high compatibility. Looking at retrieved experiences with smooth, clean, rigid surfaces (beaker: 0.76 N, 500g weight: 1.03 N), the required normal force is low due to strong adhesion. Averaging and adjusting for the slight texture of the glaze yields a predicted normal force of 0.95 N.
